title: SVG Code to SVG
description: Paste SVG markup, preview it live, and download as an .svg file.
guideTitle: How to convert SVG code into a downloadable SVG file
guideContent: Write or paste raw SVG markup and instantly see a live rendering. The tool validates your code in real-time, highlights errors, and lets you export a clean .svg file — no server uploads, no design software needed.

faqs.question: What is SVG?
faqs.answer: SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics) is an XML-based format for vector images that can be scaled to any size without losing quality.

faqs.question: Is my code safe?
faqs.answer: Yes — all processing happens entirely in your browser. Your SVG code never leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can I use custom fonts or external URLs?
faqs.answer: Inline fonts work fine. External URL references (like Google Fonts) may be blocked by browser security policies in the preview.

privacyNotes: SVG code is processed entirely in-browser. Nothing is transmitted to any server.
